title: krn adopt names a remedy for a non-repository path and each gap line
body: Found by scripts/first-day-walkthrough.ts. src/adopt/adopt.ts:615 throws "<path> is not a git repository root" with no remedy; add "run git init there, or pass --init --stack ts|php|python for an empty directory". Also each `gap <id> (reflex|finish): exit 1 from <truncated shell>` line printed by `krn adopt` on a real clone shows the check command, not the remedy; print the standard's one-line remedy instead. Regression test at the adopt receiver; extend the walkthrough probes with the adopt-on-nonrepo case. Outside this lane's scope (src/adopt/*).
